You’ll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we’re building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Join us at Better Cotton as Membership & Supply Chain Officer, LATAM & Portugal and support member engagement and the implementation of Better Cotton’s supply chain systems across the LATAM and Portugal region.

Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improve soil health across our network, improve farm income, and support women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.

Our Hiring Process

Reference Checks

Offer Stage

title: PESSOA TÉCNICO DE ENFERMAGEM HEMODIN MICA / HOSPITAL CASA PREMIUM - RJ/CLT
description:
Visão da Empresa

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Resumo da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como TÉCNICO DE ENFERMAGEM HEMODINÂMICA que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e amor pelos seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  1. Participar de dar continuidade às atividades determinadas pela gerência e coordenação de enfermagem.
  2. Exercer a função assistencial, educativa, de pesquisa e social, em concordância com a Gerência de Enfermagem.
  3. Auxiliar na identificação dos fatores que favorecem e dificultam o processo de enfermagem.
  4. Zelar pelas condições ambientais de segurança do setor, buscando o bem‑estar da equipe interdisciplina.
  5. Solucionar as intercorrências, visando um bom padrão de assistência ao cliente.
  6. Prestar assistência aos pacientes, atendendo suas necessidades básicas (higiene e conforto, apoio emocional), zelando pela sua segurança.
  7. Participar de Reuniões com a gerência, supervisão ou Coordenação de Enfermagem, quando solicitado.
  8. Participar da passagem de plantão dentro da sala operatória, checando organização da mesma, conferindo materiais, incluindo equipamentos necessários, ap (an) ate anestésico-cirúrgico e materiais que necessitam de data em dia.
  9. Fazer cumprir as normas e rotinas já existentes, incluindo CCIH de acordo com os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP).
  10. Ser assíduo, pontual e disciplinado.
  11. Manter chefia direta informada sobre as intercorrências do serviço, solicitando da mesma, quando necessário, as devidas providências.
  12. Responsabilizar‑se por todos os materiais do setor, zelando pelo uso adequado.
  13. Comunicar ao Enfermeiro supervisor qualquer defeito ou anormalidades ocorridos com matérias e equipamentos em sala.
  14. Preencher diariamente o mapa de controle de temperatura da sala de cirurgia.
  15. Avaliar diariamente a necessidade de material permanente (Braçadeira de pressão não invasiva PNI, cabo de oxímetro, etc.) e comunicar à sua chefia imediata para reposição.
  16. Avaliar diariamente a necessidade de material descartável para consumo (campos de cobertura cirúrgica, campos de mesa auxiliar).
  17. Realizar diariamente a reposição dos impressos de sala cirúrgica.
  18. Usar adequadamente os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI), de acordo com ambiente e/ou tipo de material utilizado e norma regulamentadora NR32.
  19. Preencher diariamente no primeiro horário do plantão o check list da sala de cirurgia, repondo os materiais faltantes.
  20. Estar ciente quanto aos procedimentos que serão realizados na sala de hemodinâmica sob sua responsabilidade.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Nível Médio completo.
  • Curso técnico em enfermagem completo.
  • Experiência de 6 meses na função.
  • CONHECIMENTO EM PROCEDIMENTOS ESPECÍFICOS DE HEMODINÂMICA, CARDIOLOGIA.
  • Coren ativo.
  • Pacote office.

Conheça os benefícios que oferecemos para você:

  • Vale Transporte.
  • Refeição no local.
  • Convênio Médico.
  • Convênio Odontológico.

Escala 12x36.

Posição Aberta

description:
Job description

Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país! ️

Adnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.

Globalmente, adnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes.

O Líder de Operações será responsável por liderar a equipe de operadores de equipamentos e auxiliares de rampa, atuando com assertividade na gestão de pessoas e processos operacionais para promover o desenvolvimento do grupo e do setor, além de garantir a conformidade da equipe às normas, políticas e procedimentos do departamento e da empresa.

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para oAeroporto do Galeão (GIG)!



Responsabilidades principais

  • Liderar a equipe de operadores de equipamentos e agentes de bagagem e rampa, promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional do grupo (formação de sucessores), coordenar as atividades e processos relacionados ao atendimento de aeronaves em solo (chegada e partida), atuando em conjunto com outras áreas envolvidas na operação para garantir a pontualidade do voo com qualidade e segurança, conforme as normas e procedimentos do MGO, realizar inspeções visuais na fuselagem da aeronave nas chegadas e partidas (walkaround);
  • Coletar, compilar e compartilhar informações antecipadamente com a equipe, definir responsabilidades de forma planejada, analisar a operação em loco, estabelecer objetivos priorizando demandas e atividades;
  • Analisar irregularidades ou riscos identificados, atuando na correção e prevenção por meio de briefings operacionais e reportes aos setores envolvidos;
  • Identificar e reportar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de rampa, realizar briefings operacionais e comportamentais, promover reuniões e fornecer feedbacks;
  • Coordenar atividades de movimentação de equipamentos de rampa durante descarregamento e carregamento de cargas e bagagens, orientando os colaboradores, analisando sinistralidades e atuando para evitar rupturas operacionais e perda de qualidade nos serviços.


Requisitos e habilidades

  • Ensino Superior será considerado diferencial;
  • Visão analítica e sistemática para tomada de decisão;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em pacote Office;
  • Experiência em atendimento ao cliente;
  • Habilidade de liderança e gestão de pessoas.

Nos aspectos físicos, exige-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e inferiores, postura em bipedestação, locomoção por toda a extensão do aeroporto e condução de veículos internos.

Nos aspectos sensoriais, é necessária acuidade visual para condução de veículos, suporte à equipe e acompanhamento operacional, além de percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico, comunicação com colaboradores e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos, exige-se atenção, concentração, habilidades organizacionais, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa na resolução de situações.

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the next generation of ownership management products. You’ll work closely with product, design, and go‑to‑market teams—as well as directly with top‑tier Private Equity firms and enterprise‑scale clients—to deeply understand their needs and deliver high‑quality technical solutions.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Asset Management LLC Captable team. We launched the Carta LLC product in 2020 and, after discovering a repeatable go‑to‑market motion, have been on a journey to scale it across the entire portfolio of Private Equity companies. We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows.

The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you'll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

About You

You deeply care about your user and are relentless in your pursuit to build delightful user experiences that wow the customer! You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively who can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype.

  • You have 5+ years of full‑stack or backend engineering experience.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Java, Datadog, REST / GRPC, Kafka, K8s, AWS).
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business and marketing.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.

The Interview Process

Carta follows a standard tech startup interview process, where you will meet with a recruiter and hiring manager first. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list) and virtual interviews. During the process, you can ask questions to people across different parts of the Fund Administration team to learn what kind of work we do and how it lines up with your interests.

Disclosures:

  • We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.

Responsável por fornecer soluções inovadoras para os problemas dos clientes, ou seja, capturar os requisitos de negócios e transformá-los por meio de análise e design em soluções técnicas.


Principais atividades

  • Atuar na análise de requisitos de negócio e na definição de soluções técnicas, com foco em inovação e aderência às necessidades dos clientes;
  • Projetar e definir arquiteturas de sistemas complexos, novos ou legados, considerando escalabilidade, segurança, desempenho e interoperabilidade;
  • Conduzir o levantamento técnico de requisitos junto a stakeholders, traduzindo demandas funcionais e não funcionais em especificações arquiteturais;
  • Elaborar propostas técnicas detalhadas, incluindo modelos de arquitetura, fluxos de integração e definição de componentes;
  • Realizar avaliação de sistemas existentes, identificando oportunidades de refatoração, modernização e integração;
  • Desenvolver planos de testes, estratégias de validação e cronogramas de implementação para as soluções propostas;
  • Diagnosticar e propor soluções para problemas técnicos relacionados à comunicação entre sistemas, serviços e plataformas;
  • Gerenciar projetos técnicos: controle de demandas, avaliação de viabilidade, acompanhamento de entregas e produção de documentação técnica;
  • Aplicar técnicas de inteligência artificial e aprendizado de máquina para apoiar a automação de processos, análise preditiva, classificação de dados e melhoria contínua das soluções desenvolvidas.


Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

  • Conhecimento em Microsoft 365: Administração de ambientes e serviços, com foco em gestão de identidades, grupos, políticas de segurança e conformidade;
  • Power Platform: Administração de ambientes, incluindo Dataverse;
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações em Power Apps (model-driven, canvas e portal);
  • Automação de processos e integração de sistemas utilizando Power Automate;
  • SharePoint Online: Gestão de Site Collections, desenvolvimento de sites modernos, estruturação de conteúdo e aplicação de políticas de governança;
  • Azure: Administração de Resource Groups, monitoramento de serviços, análise de desempenho e resolução de falhas com base em logs e métricas;
  • SQL Server (Azure e On-premises): Execução de queries, administração de bancos de dados, gerenciamento de gateways e publicação de dashboards no Power BI;
  • Power BI: Criação de dashboards interativos, administração de workspaces e integração com fontes de dados diversas;
  • Copilot Studio: Desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em inteligência artificial, incluindo a criação de agentes personalizados para automação de atendimento e integração com sistemas corporativos;

description:
Senior Customer Success Analyst (Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo)

Join to apply for the Senior Customer Success Analyst (Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo) role at Equinix .

Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Equinix is a global digital infrastructure company, operating more than 260 data centers worldwide. Digital leaders use Equinix’s reliable platform to connect and interconnect core infrastructure at the speed of software. Equinix enables organizations to access all the right places, partners and possibilities to scale with agility, accelerate the launch of digital services, deliver world‑class experiences and multiply their value, while supporting sustainability goals.

As a Senior Customer Success Analyst, you will strategically drive three core pillars to the business:

  • Relationship with Field Sales customers: provide direct support to strategic, large accounts, ensuring an excellent experience from first contact.
  • Support to sales with a focus on upselling: work side‑by‑side with the commercial team, identifying expansion opportunities and proposing solutions that align with customer needs.
  • Retention and customer loyalty: lead an effective onboarding and maintain continuous follow‑up, analyzing metrics, controlling churn and proactively preventing and resolving issues to ensure customer satisfaction and continued engagement.

Integration of Clients

Use judgment to tailor the best client interaction approach, considering their needs and the scope of the project. Follow the 3‑phase methodology:

  • Phase 1 – Pre‑integration: Perform preparatory activities with all clients.
  • Phase 2 – Initial meeting: Schedule, facilitate and conduct initial integration meetings.
  • Phase 3 – Continuous follow‑up: Establish a regular cadence of contact to monitor client evolution.

You may lead integrations across regions in partnership with other Customer Success Managers (CSMs). Translate internal processes clearly, align expectations and positively influence clients and stakeholders.

Relationship and Personalization

Interact with cross‑functional teams, collect detailed client information to personalize experiences and understand strategic direction. After onboarding, follow up on actions and tasks linked to client goals. Identify trends and ask strategic questions to deepen business understanding.

Adoption and Customer Success Management

Develop, maintain and monitor Customer Success Plans across scopes. Promote product and process adoption based on usage trends. Share product knowledge to empower clients. Collect and manage feedback, proposing continuous improvements based on client insights.

Strategic Collaboration

Collaborate with account teams in pre‑sales discussions, acting as a customer advocate. Ensure smooth transitions across internal areas. Lead special projects with cross‑functional teams, including global accounts. Implement best practices and maintain proactive client contact.

Issue and Escalation Management

Assess and prioritize issues and escalations, ensuring visibility and proper resolution. Work with stakeholders to enforce policies and procedures, communicating resolutions and improvement plans with clarity and empathy.

Account Retention

Partner with sales and management for account oversight. Support contractual obligations, proactively identify churn risks and contribute to retention strategies. Conduct regular operational reviews and manage follow‑up projects.

Main Requirements

  • Completed higher education.
  • Advanced English (interview in English).
  • Prior experience in Customer Success, Post‑sales, Technical Support or Consulting.
  • Experience handling a diverse, extensive B2B client portfolio.
  • Knowledge of customer success metrics (NPS, churn, CSAT, health score).
  • Familiarity with CRM tools and CS platforms (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Previous direct collaboration with the sales team.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in technology companies (SaaS, Cloud, Infrastructure or Data Center).

Job Title

Quality Engineer - Data Test Engineer (IDMC)

Company: IBM

Introduction

In this role, you will work in one of our IBM Consulting Client Innovation Centers (Delivery Centers), delivering deep technical and industry expertise to a wide range of public and private sector clients worldwide. Our delivery centers provide locally based skills and technical expertise to drive innovation and adoption of new technology.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer at IBM, your technical skills will directly impact the quality of the software we create. You will help each agile iteration reach the next level, whether the testing is manual, automated, or cognitive, ensuring the best deliverables for our clients and IBM.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Data Test Engineer with a strong background in Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) .
  • Responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and accuracy of data across on‑premise and cloud environments.
  • Validate data migration, transformation, and integration processes using Informatica IDMC.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to guarantee seamless data ingestion from multiple sources—including streaming technologies, cloud platforms, and various data stores—while maintaining the highest standards of data quality and consistency.

Essential Job Functions

  • Design, develop, and execute test plans and test cases for data pipelines and workflows built with Informatica IDMC.
  • Perform data validation and transformation testing to verify completeness, consistency, and accuracy between source and target systems.
  • Develop and maintain automated data validation frameworks using Python, SQL, and IDMC’s built‑in tools and APIs.
  • Implement data quality rules and support continuous integration through CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with development, operations, and infrastructure teams to identify and resolve data quality issues.
  • Document test plans, test results, and findings in a clear and traceable manner.
  • Support testing activities related to data migration, profiling, analysis, and transformation.
  • Manage defect tracking and reporting, ensuring timely resolution and transparent communication.
  • Contribute to process improvements and testing best practices within an Agile environment.
  • Work closely with cross‑functional teams to support ongoing data governance and compliance initiatives.

Technical Responsibilities

  • IDMC Development and Testing:
    • Understand and create end‑to‑end mappings in IDMC using Filters, Routers, Joiners, and JSON functions.
    • Handle JSON parsing, JSON structures, and JSON strings using the Structure Parser in IDMC.
    • Apply basic Java to write and execute small code snippets when required.
  • Python Coding:
    • Develop functions to read and process data from various file formats.
    • Use libraries such as Pandas for data analysis, manipulation, and validation.
  • Azure Cloud Tools:
    • Utilize Azure Data Factory (ADF), PySpark, or similar technologies to support data integration and transformation testing.
  • Database and SQL Work:
    • Write and optimize SQL queries to validate data between source and target.
    • Ensure data accuracy and completeness within large‑scale datasets.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Solid understanding of software development and delivery in a data‑centric environment.
  • Proficiency with Informatica IDMC and related tools.
  • Strong SQL skills for data validation and transformation.
  • Experience with Python scripting and data libraries (e.g., Pandas).
  • Familiarity with Azure Cloud technologies (ADF, PySpark, or similar).
  • Ability to interpret and draw system and architecture diagrams.
  • Understanding of modern cloud technologies and data governance principles.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Comfortable working collaboratively within an Agile environment.
  • Advance English is a must.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high‑quality work within deadlines.
  • Proactive, collaborative, and curious mindset with a passion for data quality.

title: Modélisation de tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements de terrain
description:
Modélisation de tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements de terrain

Cadre scientifique: ANR MEGA

Les glissements sous-marins géants km³) sont présents dans les séries sédimentaires Quaternaire des marges continentales passives. Si leurs âges coïncident avec des fluctuations eustatiques, il est encore difficile d’expliquer comment d’aussi grandes ruptures sont générées sur de faibles pentes (<2˚) en l'absence d'un facteur déclenchant tel qu’un séisme. Des hypothèses proposent le rôle de la dissociation des hydrates de gaz et de l’augmentation des pressions interstitielles. Le projet MEGA explorera ces hypothèses grâce aux premières modélisations reliant la stabilité des hydrates de gaz, les variations de pression/température sur le fond marin et la stabilité des pentes. Il s’appuyera sur une comparaison innovante des systèmes du Nil et de l'Amazone, leurs forçages climatiques différant au cours des cycles glaciaires-interglaciaires. En l’absence de cas historiques de méga glissements, MEGA propose de modéliser leurs conséquences en terme de tsunami sur les zones côtières.

L’objectif est de modéliser et simuler numériquement des tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements sous-marins géants en s'appuyant sur le couplage de deux codes numériques existants: Shaltop pour le glissement de terrain, et Freshkiss3D pour la propagation du tsunami.

La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec des géologues de L'Institut des Sciences de la Terre de Paris (ISTeP) et des mathématicien·nes de l'équipe projet ANGE inria Paris/LJLL.

  • Étude de stratégies de couplage numérique entre Shaltop et Freshkiss3D.
  • Simulation de différents scénarios de glissements de terrain géants sur des zones géographiques précises.
  • Déterminer le rôle de la stratification en température de l'océan

La personne recrutée pourra s'appuyer sur l'approche numérique développée lors d'une précédente collaboration (ANR ALBAMAR) et sur les résultats déjà obtenus dans le cadre de ce projet.

Lieux de travail :

ISTeP, Sorbonne Université, Paris. De courts séjours chez les partenaires du projet sont susceptibles d'avoir lieu (UMR Géoazur, UMR EPOC, Linnaeus University en Suède, Fluminense Federal University et Université d'état de Rio de Janeiro au Brésil).

Collaboration :

La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec Sara Lafuerza (ISTeP), Nina Aguillon (LJLL/ Inria Paris), Jacques Sainte-Marie (Inria Paris) et Bernard Di Martino (Université de Corse).

Responsabilités :

La personne recrutée a la charge de développer le couplage numérique et prendra des initiatives pour communiquer les résultats obtenus aux partenaires du projet.

Pilotage/Management :

La personne recrutée pourra être amener à former un/une étudiante en thèse à la simulation numérique.

Principales activés :

  • Implémenter des scénarios de réaction de l'océan à un glissement sous-marin géant
  • Déterminer les paramètres pertinents
  • Présenter l’avancée des travaux aux partenaires
  • Proposer des améliorations de stratégie numérique

Activités complémentaires :

  • Participer à l'écriture des rapports
  • Initier à l'utilisation du code les partenaires du projet
  • Restauration subventionnée
  • Transports publics remboursés partiellement
  • Congés: 7 semaines de congés annuels + 10 jours de RTT (base temps plein) + possibilité d’autorisations d’absence exceptionnelle (ex : enfants malades, déménagement)
  • Possibilité de télétravailet aménagement du temps de travail
  • Équipements professionnels à disposition (visioconférence, prêts de matériels informatiques, etc.)
  • Prestations sociales, culturelles et sportives (Association de gestion des œuvres sociales d'Inria)
  • expérience en simulation numérique en mécanique des fluides
  • capacité à travailler en équipe

Overview


Statkraft is a leading company in hydropower internationally and Europe’s largest generator of renewable energy. The Group produces hydropower, wind power, solar power, gas-fired power and supplies district heating. Statkraft is a global company in energy market operations. Statkraft has 3500 employees in 15 countries.


The main activities of the Business Area Market Operations & IT are energy management for Statkraft’s assets, trading & origination and market access services in Europe, South America and India. In addition, the business area contains local business support, finance & risk support, and IT services. In M there are 750 employees. The market operations of Statkraft are performed in the offices of Amsterdam, Düsseldorf, Stockholm, Istanbul, London, New Delhi, Oslo, Rio de Janeiro and Trondheim.

Responsible for developing, controlling and reporting Profit / Loss (P / L), market and credit risk metrics, risk methodologies and mitigation strategies.   • Control and report the business financial performance represented by the Profit/Loss (P/L) metrics, through analysis of spreadsheets/systems, ensuring that all input data (data from the energy purchase and sale agreements, inflation, fx and interest curve) are correctly captured and updated;

Solid Experience in the risk analysis area.

Statistics and Econometric


Advanced Excel and Programming Skills (python, R)

Analysis of Financial Statements

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Job Description

The position

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

Key responsibilities

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE.
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required.
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team.
  • Prepare and manage a health- & safety plan.
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project.
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management.
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments.

Your profile

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes.
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Experiência de Quem Faz

A Serviços Integrados TecBan nasceu da experiência na gestão da maior rede de caixas eletrônicos em volume de saques, o Banco24Horas. Depois de muitos anos fazendo acontecer com o Banco24Horas, decidimos compartilhar a nossa excelência e experiência com o mercado.

Temos diversas bases espalhadas pelo Brasil, todas com uma infraestrutura tecnológica avançada e investimento contínuo em tecnologia e segurança.

Reiterando nosso compromisso com a diversidade e inclusão, convidamos pessoas negras, indígenas, mulheres, pessoas com deficiência, pessoas de diversas gerações e 50+, pessoas neurodivergentes e pessoas LGBTQIAPN+ a enviarem suas candidaturas para as vagas de estágio, aprendiz e trabalho no grupo TecBan.

  • Liderar, em conjunto com o time operacional, análises de causa raiz em casos de não conformidade ou problemas nas operações, realizando interface entre cliente, armador, Vibra e outros envolvidos;
  • Desenvolver aos times de logística e operações, planos de contingência para falhas operacionais, climáticas ou incidentes ambientais;
  • Atuar na gestão de compliance e mitigação de riscos ambientais, incluindo respostas a incidentes;

title: Diretor Comercial - Avitum
description:
Acreditamos em um futuro sustentável com um olhar sensível às mudanças globais, e às necessidades individuais da vida que são o nosso maior propósito. Acreditamos na Inovação, e que juntos continuaremos vivendo intensamente nossa missão de Salvar e Proteger vidas ao redor do mundo. Estamos atuando na construção de uma empresa mais diversa e inclusiva. Nosso objetivo é oferecer um ambiente de respeito, contribuindo com a diminuição das diferenças e desenvolvendo atividades e ações relacionadas à diversidade, equidade e inclusão.

Nosso compromisso é fomentar processos seletivos justos, transparentes e inclusivos, independente do gênero, raça, etnia, religião, idade, orientação sexual ou deficiência dos candidatos que se aplicam às nossas posições.

E se você, assim como nós, é movido por salvar vidas e tornar o sucesso do cliente uma crescente constante, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Missão

Liderar a estratégia e a execução comercial para os portfólios de Diálise (aguda e crônica) e Tratamento Avançado de Feridas (Advanced Wound Care - WOC), incluindo Prevenção de Infecções. Assegurar o desenvolvimento, a comunicação e a implementação de estratégias que impulsionem o crescimento sustentável, fortaleçam a presença de mercado da B. Braun e entreguem valor a pacientes, provedores de saúde e a todos os stakeholders.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Estabelecer, comunicar e implementar a estratégia comercial para Diálise, Tratamento Avançado de Feridas e Prevenção de Infecções.
  • Desenvolver e manter um plano de comunicação claro e adaptado a todos os stakeholders envolvidos nas decisões de compra.
  • Acompanhar ativamente as equipes de vendas em campo, medir a eficácia da estratégia e adaptar as iniciativas conforme necessário para garantir a melhoria contínua.
  • Garantir a participação da equipe em treinamentos fornecidos pelas unidades de negócios globais, bem como aqueles definidos pelo departamento de treinamento local.
  • Desenvolver competências de excelência comercial em toda a equipe.
  • Assegurar a aderência a todos os processos internos de compliance e políticas corporativas.
  • Construir e manter relacionamentos sólidos com Formadores de Opinião (KOLs) e stakeholders importantes para posicionar a B. Braun como uma parceira confiável.
  • Fomentar a colaboração com outras áreas de negócio para alavancar sinergias e fortalecer a marca B. Braun no mercado.
  • Apoiar a tomada de decisão em conjunto com Gerentes Regionais para contas-chave dentro da divisão, garantindo alinhamento e negociações eficazes.
  • Garantir o alcance da meta de orçamento atribuída e assumir total responsabilidade pelo desempenho de P&L (Lucros e Perdas) na divisão.
  • Liderar pelo exemplo, inspirar e motivar as equipes, e desenvolver futuros líderes dentro da organização.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em ciências da saúde, Medicina, Enfermagem, Engenharia Biomédica ou área relacionada (pós-graduação é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comercial comprovada no setor de dispositivos médicos ou saúde, preferencialmente em equipamentos de diálise e/ou tratamento avançado de feridas.
  • Fortes habilidades de liderança, com histórico comprovado de gestão de equipes multidisciplinares e alcance de metas de negócio.
  • Capacidade demonstrada de gerenciar P&L, construir estratégias comerciais e entregar crescimento sustentável.
  • Excelentes habilidades de negociação e gestão de stakeholders, com experiência na construção de parcerias de longo prazo.
  • Fluência em Inglês é obrigatória.
  • Forte compromisso com compliance, conduta ética nos negócios e valores corporativos.
  • Alta adaptabilidade, resiliência e um estilo de liderança mão na massa com presença em campo.

Local de trabalho

Flamengo, Rio de Janeiro

Ser parte e incentivadores das mudanças que acreditamos que tornarão o mundo um lugar melhor para se estar. Guardiões do claro propósito que nos move: Vidas! Ser o elo entre o Sharing Expertise de ontem, hoje e sempre. Patrocinadores dos frutos dessa conexão em prol da vida! Reconhecer e investir nas oportunidades. Fazer parte da descoberta de soluções eficazes e tecnologias, que trazem em seu DNA, o desafio de proteger e melhorar a saúde das pessoas ao redor do mundo. Este é o propósito que nos une, e nos torna B. Braun. O muito que caminhamos até aqui é o nosso impulso para tudo o que, juntos, construiremos a partir de agora, neste movo mundo!

title: Médico do Trabalho
description:
Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Overview

Estamos em busca de um Médico do Trabalho que será responsável em contribuir para promoção da saúde e segurança da força de trabalho, a partir da prevenção, do controle e da eliminação de riscos no ambiente de trabalho com o objetivo de prevenir perdas relacionadas às pessoas e ao patrimônio material da empresa.

Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia!

Traga a sua energia para a Light!

Seus desafios serão:

Responsibilities

  • Realizar exames médicos ocupacionais e clínicos conforme os riscos dos postos de trabalho.
  • Atender emergências médicas e realizar encaminhamentos adequados.
  • Integrar-se à equipe de enfermagem do trabalho, promovendo saúde e segurança.
  • Avaliar acidentes e doenças ocupacionais, emitindo pareceres técnicos.
  • Acompanhar colaboradores acidentados, inclusive em ambiente hospitalar.
  • Analisar postos de trabalho para identificar e minimizar riscos à saúde.
  • Elaborar laudos e relatórios sobre acidentes, doenças e insalubridade.
  • Prestar primeiros socorros e organizar remoções em casos graves.
  • Promover ações de saúde com base em dados epidemiológicos.
  • Participar de auditorias médicas e do gerenciamento de saúde ocupacional.

Qualifications

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina
  • Especialização em Medicina do Trabalho com registro no Conselho Regional de Medicina - RQE.
  • Conhecimento sólido em legislação de Medicina do Trabalho, com ênfase nas Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) do Ministério do Trabalho, nas diretrizes dos Conselhos Federal e Regional de Medicina, da ANAM e do Ministério da Saúde.
  • Domínio de técnicas de gestão de saúde ocupacional, alinhadas às premissas do Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional (PCMSO) da empresa, com foco na prevenção de riscos e promoção da saúde dos colaboradores.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas e softwares de gestão de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho, para registro, análise e acompanhamento de dados ocupacionais.

What we offer

  • Vale Alimentação e/ou Vale Refeição
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados
  • Previdência privada
  • Seguro de vida
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de treinamentos
  • Wellhub

* Todas as nossas vagas também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência ;)

Nosso propósito é transformar a sociedade por meio da nossa energia, levando desenvolvimento e bem-estar por onde passamos todos os dias. E fazer parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros, por mais de um século, só reforça a nossa contribuição com o crescimento econômico e social do país.

title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Email Marketing Manager role at Darkroom

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth‑stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e‑commerce marketplace, direct‑to‑consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high‑impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest‑growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results‑driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About The Role

We are looking for a highly innovative, data‑driven Email Marketing Manager, who’s motivated by the challenge of working with some of the fastest growing e‑commerce and digital brands. You will join a team of email, SMS and retention marketing industry experts to drive client revenue, partner with internal cross‑functional colleagues to go deeper on understanding our customer needs and insights with a specific focus on deepening retention and building loyalty. You will lead a cross‑functional team to build creative strategies in email and SMS campaign development to help our clients grow.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Spain, Mexico, Portugal, and Brazil.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, with hands‑on retention experience.
  • You immerse yourself in scaling personalized D2C/e‑commerce email and SMS programs that build deep customer relationships for clients.
  • You can creatively message the value propositions of any brand’s product catalog to create email and SMS campaigns that customers find to be engaging, informative, and persuasive.
  • You’re passionate about developing creative customer journeys and loyalty programs that drive loyalty and lifetime value.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo (or a similar ESP’s) including list segmentation, lifecycle drip automations, and triggered events. Additionally, you have knowledge of Shopify and their tech stack options such as Privy, JustUno, Yotpo, Octane AI, etc.
  • You have developed SMS and loyalty programming strategies and have experience working with SMS platforms such as Attentive, PostScript, SMSBump, or Klaviyo.
  • You’re used to working in a fast paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You love making data driven decisions and excel at turning analytics into actionable SMS and email strategies that drive client revenue.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.
  • You have experience developing and executing customer loyalty programs that enhance LTV.
  • You’ve had at least one direct report before and exceptional leadership skills working with cross‑functional teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

A Day in the Life

  • Serve as the primary retention lead for select clients, working to develop best‑in‑class retention strategies. On a bi‑weekly basis, you will lead meetings with clients to discuss current and future initiatives.
  • Report on strategic KPIs for clients, creating insights and actionable recommendations to grow client retention engagement and revenue.
  • Develop strategic campaign calendars and prioritize projects and initiatives designed to scale your clients’ email, SMS, loyalty and subscription programs.
  • Project manage and delegate campaign briefs to your team, consisting of both retention specialists and designers.
  • Review all client briefs and designs for approval before they are sent to the client to ensure campaign quality and accuracy.
  • Assign segmentation and QA email and SMS campaigns ensuring flawless delivery to customer audiences.
  • Execute on automation/flow logic set‑up, pop‑up builds, and app integrations.
  • Coordinate cross‑departmentally with the Growth, Digital, and Marketplaces teams to develop cohesive campaigns that drive client growth.

Working at Darkroom

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

title: People Operations Generalist
description:
WHAT WE DO MATTERS:

At The Knot Worldwide, we champion celebration - and that starts with celebrating our people. Our employees are passionate dreamers, thoughtful doers, and lifelong learners who power meaningful moments for millions around the world. We’re united by authentic connection, shared purpose, and a deep commitment to the global community we serve. Here, flexibility and belonging go hand in hand with high performance. We believe the best ideas come from empowered teams: those who consistently collaborate with intention to design solutions, spark ideas, and drive impact. Our people are at the heart of our success.

Please submit your CV in English.

ABOUT THE ROLE AND OUR TEAM:

The People Operations Generalist role at TKWW will provide some operational support to People BPs, but with a renewed focus on process standardization, HR systems management, and data ownership. People Operations is responsible for setting the global standards, processes, and policies for all employee lifecycle changes, and the Generalist will play a key role in ensuring these processes are executed flawlessly across all regions . The People Operations Generalist will manage administrative tasks related to the employee lifecycle (such as onboarding, offboarding, promotions, merit adjustments, etc.), but with an increased emphasis on process alignment, systems management, and data integrity. As the "guardians of the data," People Operations is accountable for the accuracy and reliability of employee information, and you will help maintain this high standard by ensuring that all data and lifecycle changes are recorded and updated correctly.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Employee Lifecycle Management: Manage and execute the end-to-end employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, promotions, merit adjustments, and employee transfers. Ensure all changes are documented accurately in HR systems, in employee files, in documented employee memos, and aligned with company policies and local labor laws.
  • HR Systems Management & Data Integrity: Oversee and maintain employee data within the HR systems (e.g., HRIS, ATS, in collaboration with payroll). As a key member of the People Ops team, you will ensure that all employee lifecycle changes are accurately tracked and aligned with standard operating procedures. You will be responsible for ensuring the integrity of employee data, making sure it is up-to-date and reflects changes accurately across systems.
  • Process Standardization & Execution: Follow and execute standardized People Operations processes for all employee lifecycle events, ensuring compliance with global policies and local regulations. Support the continuous improvement of these processes to increase efficiency and streamline workflows.
  • Collaboration with Total Rewards: Support the People Operations team in areas related to Total Rewards, including compensation and benefits. You may assist with administering benefits programs, ensuring accuracy in pay and benefit-related changes, and liaising with external vendors or partners for benefits enrollment and compensation adjustments.
  • Ad Hoc People Operations Support: Provide general support to the broader People Operations function on various initiatives, including but not limited to compliance projects, mandatory compliance training, and other HR programs.
  • Regional & Global Partnership:
    • Work closely with global People Ops teams to ensure processes and initiatives are aligned across regions. In the absence of a local HRBP or People Ops team, you will be relied upon to handle a broad range of employee needs and act as a key resource for your region.
    • You will have the opportunity to partner with broader teams to provide additional support in areas such as Total Rewards (compensation and benefits), new hire orientation .
    • You may be asked to provide local support for answering employee inquiries, providing guidance on company policies, benefits or other essential information, and acting as a liaison between employees and the global People teams.

SUCCESSFUL PEOPLE OPERATIONS GENERALIST CANDIDATES HAVE:

  • Experience: 3-5 years of experience in an HR Generalist, or People Operations role, with strong experience supporting employee lifecycle management processes (onboarding, offboarding, promotions, etc.), HR systems management, and compliance.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus.
  • HR Systems & Data Management: Familiarity with HRIS systems and experience with data entry, system management, and reporting. Strong attention to detail and a passion for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of employee data.
  • Process-Oriented Mindset: Experience in implementing and executing standardized HR processes, with a focus on streamlining workflows and maintaining compliance with global and local policies.
  • Regional Expertise (where applicable): Experience working in specific geographic regions with an understanding of local labor laws and HR practices. In regions where you are the sole People Ops representative, the ability to take ownership of various HR functions, including performance management and employee relations, will be critical.
  • Total Rewards Knowledge: A basic understanding of compensation, benefits, and rewards programs is a plus, particularly in how these programs impact the employee lifecycle.
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to liaise between employees, People BPs, and other key stakeholders. Comfortable working across cultures and with diverse teams.
  • Adaptability & Problem-Solving: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple tasks simultaneously. You should be proactive, adaptable, and able to problem-solve as challenges arise.
  • Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail, especially when handling employee data, documentation, and system updates.
  • Educational Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. HR certifications (e.g., SHRM-CP, PHR) are a plus.

WORK MODEL: This role is fully remote and not tied to any specific office location. While there are no regular in-office requirements, we encourage our remote team members to gather intentionally for key company and team events to stay connected and engaged.

At The Knot Worldwide, we believe you are more than a resume and invite you to go for it, take the leap of faith, and apply for this job if it sparks your passion to join TKWW and make a difference!

WHAT YOU LOVE ABOUT US:

We believe in a wide range of holistic offerings to support our employees so that they can live our values day in and day out. From mental wellbeing, physical health and financial planning, to engaging perks and discounts, we are in the business of celebrating and supporting the Moments that Matter both in and out of the “office”. We offer flexible vacation, generous parental leave and prioritize initiatives that support the growth, development, and happiness of our people.

is our approach to hybrid work. It’s designed to support how we work best: combining the flexibility we value with meaningful opportunities to connect in person. Whether a role is or not, we believe in purposeful moments to come together, build strong relationships, and drive bold ideas forward.

  • For roles, this includes regular in-office time to foster collaboration and connection.
  • For roles not eligible for in-office expectations , we support connection through virtual collaboration and intentional gatherings.

To facilitate in-person collaboration, we have office spaces in Barcelona, Spain; Delhi, India; Galway, Ireland; London, England; New York, NY; and Washington, D.C.

The Knot Worldwide expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. We seek a resourceful candidate who can effectively navigate the organization to gather necessary information and implement innovative solutions while adapting to evolving scenarios and leveraging valuable resources creatively.

Impacto

About The Team / Role

Our Sales Coordinators will work in DriverLab’s team, focused on innovation projects for our drivers. Being part of the DriverLab team will give you the unique opportunity to help drive growth in one of the fastest growing companies ever. This role is based on developing new partnerships, coordinating the sales vertical in a new region, leading the acquisition and partnership development, through the deal with gas stations to join the new 99’s marketplace: 99Abastece. Be prepared for a fast‑paced, challenging and joyful environment.

In this role, you'll be...

  • Focus on great execution with the sales team to develop new partnerships on the 99Abastece business, being responsible for the initial contact stage, until the completion of the onboarding process and the engagement dynamics.
  • Support team management: manage acquisition, activation and support team (third party).

  • Ensure collaboration with stakeholder teams to improve operational productivity (marketing, S&Ops, HR, legal, procurement).
  • Create a fun, inclusive, and safe work culture: build a hard‑working, challenging but fun workplace. Above all else, ensure engagement and development of your team.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  • 4–5 years of experience in sales B2B/B2C, fuel market, food delivery, strategy consulting or other professional services with a proven track record using data to drive business decisions.
  • Great ability of negotiation and relationship.

  • Self‑motivated, self‑directed, and eager to take ownership of tasks to ensure solutions.
  • Intermediate English knowledge: the position may require interaction with international stakeholders living in Brazil and abroad.
  • Problem‑solving aptitude – ability to break down ambiguous problems, put structure into them and use data‑driven insights to solve them.
  • Clear communicator – concise and able to synthesize a lot of information quickly and highlight key insights.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software tools and working in a business with constant changes.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

  • We create user value – always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.
  • We are data‑driven and make informed decisions by analyzing valuable metrics.
  • Win‑win collaboration – success is a team sport. We communicate with candor and execute with excellence.
  • Integrity is at the core of our business – we do the right thing and listen to each other.
  • Growth – we venture beyond our comfort zones, learn from mistakes and help each other grow.
  • Diversity and Inclusion – we respect each other and practice equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is a non‑negotiable value of who we are. We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. Our Governance of the Diversity Committee works with HR, leadership and identity groups – 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written; there remains a long road before us. The position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance, while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients.

  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.

  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages

  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.

  • You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.

  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers.

  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.

  • Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are:

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients.

  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.

  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry.

  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.

  • You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.

  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 2-4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e-commerce, etc.

  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.

  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside of the box to create new best-in-class customer experiences.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

O profissional será peça-chave na sustentação de pipelines, automação de deploys, governança de APIs e segurança das integrações, assegurando performance e integridade dos fluxos críticos de dados.

A nossa empresa é feita por gente. Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia.

Traga a sua energia para aLight !

Seus desafios serão:

  • Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de integração entre o SAP (ERP e IS-U HANA) e sistemas legados, utilizando ferramentas modernas de automação e orquestração.
  • Garantir que todas as integrações respeitem os padrões de segurança da informação, auditoria, criptografia e compliance regulatório.
  • Desenvolver e monitorar APIs, middlewares (SAP PI/PO, CPI, etc.), conectores e mensagerias (ex: Kafka, RabbitMQ), assegurando o funcionamento contínuo dos fluxos de dados.
  • Estabelecer boas práticas de versionamento, CI/CD, segregação de ambientes, testes automatizados e rollback.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de BASIS, segurança, infraestrutura, desenvolvimento ABAP/Java e fornecedores externos.
  • Apoiar o controle de acesso a serviços de integração, utilizando mecanismos como OAuth2, certificados digitais, SAML, etc.
  • Monitorar, diagnosticar e resolver falhas nos pipelines de integração com foco em resiliência.
  • Documentar fluxos, endpoints, dependências e procedimentos operacionais.

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em áreas de TI.

Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. To do this well, we must continuously raise the bar on software quality—without compromising developer velocity.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer II , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.

You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.

You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.

The Team You'll Work With

The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.

About You

  • Strong programming expertise in one OOP language like Python, Java, JS or Go (Python preferred)

  • Deep practical understanding of test strategies (unit, integration, E2E, performance, load testing).

  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset
  • You are a self-starter who thrives on solving open-ended problems, not just executing Jira tickets
  • You identify pattern and recurring issues proactively and build scalable solutions to reduce future friction
  • You have a history of shipping test frameworks or systems used by others beyond your immediate team.
  • You have a track record of advancing quality maturity by shifting QA from hands‑on execution to developer enablement through self-service tooling and process improvements
  • You are passionate about mentoring junior level team members to help them grow and learn

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"). Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub‑projects.
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement and customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with involved government authorities to ensure smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking within the warehouse and across all venues where assets are provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities; movements of team luggage and equipment to/from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managing the entry of delivery and collection vehicles into venues during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including unloading services, determining storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside venues, and provision of FFE.
  • Where required, development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP), and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf‑cart pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy in cooperation with tournament management, legal, procurement and all item‑procurement functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking and people resources as required.
  • Managing established contracts (LSP, FFE‑ and golf‑cart provider) and ensuring all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Providing the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration‑management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attending site/venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meetings and events where an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g., Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creating and managing the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creating and managing the Event Logistics project plan, including mitigation and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruiting the Logistics team and providing leadership to the team.
  • Preparing and managing a health‑and‑safety plan.
  • Preparing and managing a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project.
  • Providing timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management.
  • Completing the final reconciliation, closing contracts and transferring knowledge post‑tournaments.

Your Profile

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics or event operations for an international event.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and project management processes.
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills.
  • Able to work in a fast‑paced, multi‑level, project‑based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery.
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events.
  • Right to work in Brazil.

  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

A Iqony Solutions do Brasil também oferece serviços no setor de energias renováveis com contratos no Brasil que somam mais de 5 GW. A empresa também possui um Centro de Operação e Monitoramento Remoto, situado no Rio de Janeiro.
